items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: Yeah Perry, my brother, taught me the first.

ctx.x: Yeah Perry, my brother, taught me the first. And the one that really looks as if it’s going to be difficult is an open G and you see someone do it and you think how do you distort your finger? And that’s really easy but it looks difficult. So but the ones that actually drove me to tears were the bar chords. But once I got hold of them, as my wife will tell you I cheat with the A shaped bar chords. You’re supposed to have these three fingers together and then that bar across. See I can’t do that so I just use the…
it into a sixth. And if I don’t want it to be a sixth I don’t hit the thinnest string. That’s how I get round it.
